name: Česneková Pomazánka (Czech Garlic Cheese Spread)
ingredients: 100 g mild Cheddar, cut into 2-3 cm pieces

steps.text: Put 100 g mild Cheddar into the mixing bowl and grate 8 sec / speed 7. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.
Put 3-4 garlic cloves into the mixing bowl and chop 3 sec / speed 8. Scrape down the sides.
Add 200 g cream cheese, 40 g mayonnaise, 1 tsp lemon juice, 1 tsp Dijon mustard if using, 0.5 tsp salt, black pepper to taste and the 100 g grated Cheddar. Mix 15 sec / speed 4.
Scrape down the sides. Mix for a further 10 sec / speed 3 if needed.
Taste and adjust the seasoning. Refrigerate for 30-60 minutes before serving to allow the garlic flavour to develop.
Serve with fresh bread, rye bread, crackers or sliced baguette. Garnish with chopped chives or parsley if desired.
